key.name: check-interval
key.summary: Public IP check interval in seconds
key.description: How often to check the current public IP address.

key.name: reset-hour
key.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when the daily IP log is cleared.

key.name: enable-geo
key.summary: Look up country, city and ISP
key.description: Query ipinfo.io once per IP change to display location and ISP details.

key.name: show-flag
key.description: Display the country flag emoji next to the IP address when geolocation is available.

key.name: notify-on-change
key.description: Show a desktop notification whenever your public IP address changes.

key.name: mask-ip
key.description: Hide most digits of the public IP in the top panel for screen sharing.

key.name: show-vpn-icon
key.description: Display a lock icon when an active VPN interface (tun, wg, tailscale, etc.) is detected.
